Diego Martinez: Hi all 1st day here. My docking station arrived but my external keyboard and mouse aren't showing up. Screen and ethernet are fine. Anyone know who handles spare docks or quick swaps?

Maya Chen: Welcome Diego! @IT Support usually handles swaps. Quick ask: which dock model is on the sticker and what OS are you on?

Diego Martinez: Model label says 'FlexHub 7'. MacBook Air (Ventura). Keystrokes do nothing on external keyboard, mouse LED blinks but not connected.

Ravi Kumar: @Diego Martinez try a simple test: disconnect the dock, plug the keyboard directly into your MacBook for 10s - does it register? Also try a different USB port on the dock if there are multiple.

Diego Martinez: Plugging keyboard straight into Mac works. Tried different ports on dock 3 still no devices. Running `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` gives: ```\nUSB Device Tree:\n  USB 3.1 Bus:\n    Host Controller Driver: AppleUSBXHCI\n    PCI Device ID: 0x15d3\n    (no connected USB devices)\n```

Maya Chen: That output matches a hub not enumerating anything. I'll ping IT. @IT Support can you create a ticket and check spare inventory? Diego, are you in Building A, 2nd floor?

IT Support: Creating ticket now. Ticket IT-4829 created: "FlexHub 7 - USB devices not enumerating". Assigned to Ravi Kumar. ETA for pickup/desk drop: same day if someone from ops can swing by, otherwise 48h courier. Please confirm desk: A2-07.

Ravi Kumar: I can swing by after standup (10:15) with a loaner FlexHub 5 we keep in ops cabinet. If that works, we can confirm hardware vs laptop.

Diego Martinez: That would be awesome, thanks Ravi. 10:15 works.

it-bot: Ticket IT-4829 status: IN_PROGRESS (assigned to Ravi Kumar)

Ravi Kumar: Swapped the hub at 10:20. New FlexHub 5 (asset FH-2209) plugged in1 keyboard/mouse detected immediately. Left a sticky with asset tag and my initials.

Diego Martinez: Confirmed working. Keyboard + mouse and two USB thumb drives all mount fine. Huge help, thanks!

Maya Chen: Welcome again  if you need help with access or the onboarding checklist (Slack channels, repos) ping me and I'll share the checklist.

Ravi Kumar: Marking IT-4829 resolved and flagging original FlexHub 7 for RMA testing. Diego, if you notice flaky behavior in the next 48h DM me and we'll check firmware updates on your dock. :white_check_mark: 

it-bot: Ticket IT-4829 status changed to RESOLVED by Ravi Kumar on 1769989120
